description.fallback: When a session opens or links a PR, it can keep watching it and act on CI and reviews.
What the agent may do when a watched PR changes. Each session can change it. Analyse, Address and Auto-fix can resume an archived session.
PRs stay linked; nothing is watched.
You’re notified; the agent isn’t woken.
The agent investigates and reports in the session, read-only.
The agent fixes; you approve pushes and replies.
The agent fixes, pushes the PR’s branch and replies. Design questions come to you first.
After this many fixing rounds on one pull request, the agent stops fixing it and asks you. Leave it empty to never stop.
Only when it’s idle and nothing is waiting on you. Archiving can be undone.
